title: Regulatory RAG — запросы
description: Что стоит один запрос, сколько он идёт и куда его увёл маршрутизатор. Источник — таблица queries, её пишет телеметрия v7.

list.name: run_id
list.label: Запуск
list.query: SELECT 'Все запуски' AS __text, '__all__' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT 'Live (NULL run_id)', '__live__' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT run_id AS __text, run_id AS __value FROM queries WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Итого цена за период
panels.description: Сумма стоимости RAG по выбранным источникам и запускам. По умолчанию ui/api/mcp; eval включается явно. Стоимость судей — в LangSmith.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(cost_usd) AS "итого"
FROM queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND ('__all__' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(run_id, '__live__') IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Доля 👎
panels.description: Отрицательные оценки к числу оценённых ответов. Пусто, пока фидбек не собирается (issue #20).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.verdict = -1) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS float8) AS "доля"
FROM feedback f
JOIN queries q USING (query_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(q.ts)
  AND q.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND ('__all__' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(q.run_id, '__live__') IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Запросы по дням
panels.description: Сколько запросов пришло за день, отдельно по источнику: ui, api, eval, mcp.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', ts) AS time,
  source AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND ('__all__' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(run_id, '__live__') IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Маршруты
panels.description: Куда маршрутизатор увёл запрос: simple, complex, clarify, abstain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  path AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND ('__all__' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(run_id, '__live__') IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Цена за запрос: p50 и p95
panels.description: Перцентили cost_usd по дням. Среднее тут врёт: один сложный маршрут дороже десяти простых.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', ts) AS time,
  CAST(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost_usd) AS float8) AS "p50",
  CAST(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost_usd) AS float8) AS "p95"
FROM queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND ('__all__' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(run_id, '__live__') IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Латентность: p50 и p95
panels.description: Перцентили latency_ms по дням. Хвост p95 — то, что видит недовольный пользователь.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', ts) AS time,
  CAST(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS float8) AS "p50",
  CAST(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS float8) AS "p95"
FROM queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND ('__all__' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(run_id, '__live__') IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Последние 👎
panels.description: Промахи по одному: вопрос, маршрут, цена и комментарий. query_id — ключ, по которому строка запроса поднимается в базе целиком.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  f.ts AS "когда",
  q.question AS "вопрос",
  q.path AS "маршрут",
  q.cost_usd AS "цена",
  f.comment AS "комментарий",
  q.query_id AS "query_id"
FROM feedback f
JOIN queries q USING (query_id)
WHERE f.verdict = -1 AND $__timeFilter(q.ts)
  AND q.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND ('__all__' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(q.run_id, '__live__') IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY f.ts DESC
LIMIT 50
